prose: Bloomberg reports, citing Adzuna, that UK entry-level job postings mentioning AI are up about 3x since early 2025, and Indeed says one in six vacancies in AI-exposed fields now mentions AI, double last year. AI skills are no longer optional for young Britons seeking a first job.
highlights: UK entry-level postings mentioning AI up ~3x since early 2025 (Adzuna)
One in six vacancies in AI-exposed fields mentions AI, 2x YoY (Indeed)
